name: smartnest
description: SmartNest — Your entire home. One intelligent control centre.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @smartnest/server" "npm run dev -w @smartnest/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @smartnest/server && npm run build -w @smartnest/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @smartnest/shared && npm run test -w @smartnest/server && npm run test -w @smartnest/web
